channel.title: Neuron Flame
channel.description: Voice-to-text at the speed of thought. Free, on-device dictation for macOS.

item.description:
v1.82 — Tighter About page, working donate link

  • About fits in one viewport. Updates and Donate cards now sit side-by-side near the top instead of below the fold. No scrolling to find Check for Updates.
  • Plainer copy. Dropped the WinRAR analogy in favour of straight English.
  • Donate link points at PayPal.me — the old /donate/?business=… URL needed PayPal Business donations enabled and was hitting a 404. PayPal.me handles personal accounts directly.
  • Sidebar update pill from v1.80 is unchanged and working — when this release lands on your installed v1.81, you should see the small "v1.82 ready" pill appear under the brand mark within ~10 seconds of the app launching.
